tag: Sprint 14 Task E, F117 (F114 cloud read)

qe-seven-achievements: p.3 says seven themed achievements with badges. p.4 says two types, learning and community. The guide defines its own structure.
qe-badge-topics-list: Badge Overview, p.5, pairs the seven badge names with these topics and channels, in the same order as the value. The text layer lists names and topics in sequence, and the pairing is consistent with the page order.
qe-timeline-captain-first-dates-may-chan: Timeline, p.6: only Captain is live at launch. The IMPORTANT NOTE says dates and times may change and names #announcements. Both are the guide's own caveats.
qe-unlock-pass-threshold: Step 3, p.7, states the 80% quiz pass rule for learning badges and the password revealed on completion. The guide's own rule.
qe-community-badge-password: Step 3, p.7, states the single password question for community badges and the instruction not to share passwords, which prove an unlock.
qe-verification-five-days: Step 4, p.8: share in #level-up, admins verify, allow up to five working days. The value matches.
qe-credential-eligibility: IBM Digital Credentials, p.9, lists the four eligibility criteria exactly as in the value.
qe-captain-required-first: FAQ, p.18, states Captain is needed before the other learning badges. p.13 says unlocking Captain opens the rest of the server. Both quoted correctly.
qe-discord-age-registration: Discord Step 2, p.10: the #lobby message asks whether the person registered for the 2023-24 cohort and is above age 14, to enter the server. The value matches.
qe-recordings-and-sharing-limits: FAQ, p.17, covers recording of lectures, talks and social events. FAQ, p.18, covers the sharing ban and the allowed badge images. p.2 repeats the no-sharing request. The value matches.
idq-pcie-spec-date-and-change-notice: The Disclaimer at the end of the brochure gives the change-without-notice clause and 'Specifications as of April 2021'. The text layer has one page, so p.2 is the printed page. A vendor statement about its own document, which is the scope of the document.
uva-shg-device-and-wavelengths: Introduction, p.1, states the periodic poled LNOI waveguide and the 770.08 nm to 385.04 nm SHG. The design in Section 2 uses 780 to 390 nm, but the quote is the paper's own statement of the operating wavelengths.
uva-band-definition: Introduction, p.1, states the UV-A band spans 320 nm to 400 nm at the left edge of the visible spectrum. The paper's own statement of the term.
uva-efficiency-model-definitions: Section 2, p.2, defines L as 3.5 mm, d_eff as 2 d33/pi, the mode overlap factor and the mode areas in Eqs. (1) to (4). Eq. (1) itself is taken from Ref. [21]. The value only reports the definitions and inputs, which the paper states.
uva-wafer-platform: Section 2, p.2, states the X-cut TFLN wafer from NANOLN: 600 nm LN on 2 um thermal SiO2 over silicon.
uva-fabrication-process: Section 2, p.2, describes the electrodes (Au 60 nm, Cr 30 nm), poling by high-voltage pulses, EBL with 850 nm HSQ, ICP etch to 350 nm with a 250 nm slab, and the PECVD SiO2 cap. All match the value.
uva-experimental-setup: Section 3, p.2: the tunable laser 765-781 nm, FPC, lensed fiber with 7.67 dB loss, stage at 35 C, 400 nm aspheric collimator, two band-pass filters and the power meter. The value matches.
uva-sh-fit-method: Section 3, p.3, Eq. (6) and Fig. 6: quadratic fit, on-chip SH power from the measured power times a factor, on-chip pump power as beta times Pin, sweep 2 to 12 mW. The text layer prints the factor as 101.098, probably 10^1.098 with a flattened exponent. The value says 'printed as', which is accurate to the text layer.
uva-efficiency-depends-on-loss: Section 3, pp.3-4: the authors state the efficiency value hinges on the accuracy of the 400 nm loss measurement, repeated to verify. The paper's own caveat.
uva-author-note-timing: Section 7 Author Note, p.4, states the October 2024 completion and the later awareness of Ref. [25], a pre-print on UV generation in thin film lithium niobate. The paper's own statement of timing and an uncompared concurrent work.
jin2022-dark-count-subtracted: Section 2, p.4: the dark count is subtracted from coincidence and accidental counts to eliminate dark-count noise. The paper's own processing step.
jin2022-pgr-estimator-definition: Section 2, p.4: the PGR is estimated as N1N2/N12, with N1, N2, N12 the detection rates of signal, idler and coincidences. The paper's own estimator.
jin2022-g2-measurement-method: Section 2, p.4: idler split by a 50/50 splitter, N12, N13 and N123 defined, gH(2) = N123 N1/(N12 N13), and zero-delay values normalized to the average at other 20 ns delays. The value matches.
jin2022-fabrication-process: Section 2, p.3: 100 mm wafer, 3 um oxide, 240 nm SiNx by LPCVD at 775 C, 225 nm a-Si:H by PECVD at 300 C, a-Si:H waveguides by e-beam lithography and RIE. The value matches.
jin2022-experimental-setup-pump-and-chan: Section 2, p.3: the 50 MHz mode-locked laser, four cascaded DWDM filters at 1552.5 nm, TE mode, 2.5 mm a-Si:H waveguide, Stokes at 1545.3 nm, anti-Stokes at 1559.7 nm, 200 GHz filters. The value matches.
jin2022-detection-chain: Section 2, pp.3-4: 4-channel ID281 SNSPDs with 50-100 Hz dark counts and 85% efficiency, Swabian time tagger, 1.9 dB and 2.2 dB DWDM losses, two cascaded DWDM filters with labelled 60 dB extinction. The value matches.

theory_low.uva-design-geometry: A Lumerical finite-difference eigenmode design calculation, Section 2, p.1. It is a simulation outcome, not a proved result.
theory_low.uva-simulated-mode-areas-overlap: A simulation result from Lumerical modes, Section 2, p.2. Not a proved result. The text layer flattens the exponent in A2w and Aw.
theory_low.uva-theory-efficiency-ideal-poling: A computed efficiency from Eq. (1) with simulated mode parameters for an ideal 50:50 duty cycle, Section 2, p.2. A model outcome, not a proved result.
theory_low.uva-simulated-efficiency-actual-duty-cyc: A simulated efficiency for the measured 35:65 duty cycle, Section 2, p.2. A model outcome. The 3.6-times figure is the authors' computation.
